info.about: X-Men: Destiny is an action role-playing video game based on the X-Men comic book series. It was developed by Silicon Knights.
info.trivia: It was the final game developed by Silicon Knights before the studio filed for bankruptcy in 2014.
info.why: Unsold copies were recalled and destroyed over Silicon Knights' legal dispute with Epic Games about Unreal Engine 3 code, and it was delisted digitally in 2014.
